name: aura-apimatic-context-plugin
displayName: AURA Financial Workspace & Developer Platform Plugin
description: APIMatic Context Plugin for autonomous coding agents, LLMs, and engineers building integrations on the AURA Intelligent Financial Platform.

methods.description: User or merchant authenticated session token
Backend-to-backend sandbox and server-side integration key

verifiedMerchant.description: Exclusively available to AURA accounts whose connected PayPal account has been verified as Business

features: Authoritative ground-truth selection context (multi-row selection analysis)
Ask AURA natural-language grid manipulation (apply_filters, clear_filters, apply_sorting, undo)

enforcedStandards: PayPal Orders v2 (/v2/checkout/orders) strictly enforced over deprecated v1
Idempotency PayPal-Request-Id header required on mutating financial transactions
Strict decimal currency formatting with ISO-4217 validation

recommendedAgentWorkflows.name: analyze_selected_financial_records
steps: User selects rows in transactions-grid or merchant-orders-grid
Frontend calls POST /api/grid/selection-context with selected row IDs
Backend validates record ownership and computes statistical summary
Prompt sent to POST /api/ai/ask with verified selection context
AI model responds with ground-truth financial insights without hallucination

recommendedAgentWorkflows.name: merchant_order_fulfillment
steps: Check merchantAccessEnabled on active user profile
Optionally sync carrier tracking number to customer tracking view
